name: kb
description: Write knowledge-base files: create, update, or delete via patch (*** Begin Patch / Add File / Update File / Delete File / *** End Patch). Paths are knowledge-base relative. The knowledge base holds persistent reference documents, not Miyu's memories (those go through remember_fact). Read entries with read using kb: paths; search with search_knowledge_base.
